page_title: UNI 0-2 DOR | Union Berlin v Dortmund 02/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+6' Union Berlin quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+5' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+2' Here comes the VAR decision. The goal is given and Dortmund players have a reason to celebrate!
90+1' Wait! Referee Christian Dingert has indicated he is going to review the Dortmund goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was a foul in the build-up.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' 0 - 2 Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Frederik Ronnow with a strike into the bottom right corner. He makes it 0:2.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jadon Sancho trots off the pitch and is replaced by Ramy Bensebaini (Dortmund).
86' The resulting corner from Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.

85' A nice sequence of play ends with a shot by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) from the edge of the box. The effort, however, is towards the middle of the goal where Alexander Meyer easily catches the ball.
84' That looked a certain handball by Niklas Sule (Dortmund) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
81' It will be a substitution. Chris Bedia (Union Berlin) is ready to enter the pitch as Diogo Leite walks off.
80' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) prepares to take a corner kick.
79' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
79' Marcel Sabitzer (Dortmund) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
78' Edin Terzic prepares a substitution. Karim Adeyemi is replaced by Jamie Bynoe-Gittens (Dortmund).
75' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
71' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) tries to play a through ball from just inside the box to Karim Adeyemi, but one of the defending players is alert to the danger and makes a timely interception.
69' The referee signals a substitution. Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) is brought on as a substitute for Jerome Roussillon.
69' Nenad Bjelica has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) replacing Rani Khedira.

68' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Christian Dingert blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
66' Substitution. Salih Ozcan (Dortmund) has come on for Julian Brandt.

64' Frederik Ronnow makes a brilliant save! Julian Brandt (Dortmund) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by keeper!
63' The ball rebounds out to Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) on the edge of the box. He immediately strikes for goal, but sends the ball high over the bar.
61' Nenad Bjelica has decided to substitute Lucas Tousart and he is replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) replaces Benedict Hollerbach.
61' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) has proven his good peripheral vision as he picks out Jadon Sancho with a lovely through ball.
60' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
58' Rani Khedira (Union Berlin) starts his run too early and the referee blows for offside.
56' Union Berlin take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

56' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) gets to a rebound in front of goal and sends the ball towards the middle of the goal. However, he couldn't beat Alexander Meyer, who shows off his superb goalkeeping ability by pulling off a great save.
54' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Dortmund.
52' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

52' Niclas Fullkrug (Dortmund) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the top left corner, but Frederik Ronnow thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
49' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) sends an accurate pass to Julian Brandt, who controls the ball with a fine first touch.
47' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
46' The whistle blows and Christian Dingert starts the second half.
45+6' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' The cross into the penalty area from Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
45+1' Julian Brandt (Dortmund) takes the corner but it's cleared.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' Yellow card. Julian Ryerson (Dortmund) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

41' 0 - 1 Karim Adeyemi (Dortmund) broke through the opposition's defence and from the edge of the 18-yard box unleashed a powerful effort, bouncing in off the crossbar. The goalkeeper was rooted to the spot! He surely didn't expect that. A piece of footballing magic!
38' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) releases a decent shot towards the middle of the goal from the edge of the box, but it's comfortably gathered by Frederik Ronnow.
35' A pass into the box finds Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the left side of the goal, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Frederik Ronnow denies him.
35' The referee awards a corner and Julian Brandt (Dortmund) goes over to take it.
31' Ian Maatsen (Dortmund) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
30' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
29' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Christian Dingert saw the whole situation.
26' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but Alexander Meyer comes off his line to gather the ball.
25' The resulting corner, taken by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin), comes to nothing.
24' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
23' Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
20' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
19' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
18' Jerome Roussillon (Union Berlin) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
17' It seemed like Julian Brandt (Dortmund) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
17' Jadon Sancho (Dortmund) and Emre Can matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
14' Niklas Sule (Dortmund) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Frederik Ronnow comes off the line to clear the ball away.
13' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Christian Dingert blows his whistle for an infringement.
12' Some neat passing and movement from Dortmund as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
10' Nico Schlotterbeck (Dortmund) displays his superb passing ability after picking out Julian Ryerson with a fine lofted pass to continue their attacking move.
8' There's an opportunity for Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
8' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
6' What a huge chance for Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
4' The game gets underway again after that interruption.
3' The game is interrupted.
1' The first half has just begun.
Dortmund will kick-off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Christian Dingert.
